blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers brewed on the farm, including seasonal and special edition brews. The brewery offers a food menu with items such as smoked pork shoulder, Korean-style brisket sandwiches, and vegetarian chili. They also host concerts and welcome dogs on their outdoor porch seating area.
